description: This file contains a JMH benchmark class for measuring performance of JavaScript message mapping in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino implementation. It defines benchmarking methods for various payload scenarios.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoBenchmark
classes.description: JUnit benchmark class for measuring performance of JavaScript message mapping using JMH annotations.

methods.name: simpleMapTextPayload
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario with a text payload.

methods.name: test1DecodeBinaryPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario for decoding binary payload to Ditto format.

methods.name: test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario for parsing JSON payload to Ditto format.

methods.name: test3FormatJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario for formatting JSON payload to Ditto.

methods.name: test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario for constructing JSON payload to Ditto.

methods.name: test5DecodeBinaryToDitto
methods.description: Runs the mapping scenario for decoding binary payload to Ditto.

methods.name: runScenario
methods.description: Executes the mapping scenario by invoking the message mapper on the external message.
